## BILLFORCE for Windows

**Download `Billforce-Setup.exe` below and double-click it.** BILLFORCE installs and opens; a shortcut is added to the desktop and the Start menu. No internet, Node.js or Docker needed.

- **Your data is saved on this computer**, in `%APPDATA%\BILLFORCE\data` (one file per business). It stays when BILLFORCE is updated or uninstalled.
- **Automatic backups** every day, week or month (Settings → Backup & recovery), saved in `Documents\BILLFORCE Backups` or in a folder you choose: a pen drive, an external disk or a OneDrive / Google Drive folder.
- **Bills print straight to your receipt printer**: choose it in Settings → Receipt & printer.
- Backups from the website or the browser edition can be restored in the app, and the other way round.

### New in this version
- **Your logo on bills**: add your business logo in Settings → Business. Choose what the top of the bill shows: logo and name, logo only (when your logo already has the name in it) or name only. Used on bills, quotations, credit notes and receipts, on 80 mm and 58 mm paper.
- **Send bills on WhatsApp**: the new **Save & WhatsApp** button (Alt+W) on the billing screen, and **WhatsApp** on a saved bill, open the customer's WhatsApp chat with a short message typed in and a picture (JPG) of the bill copied. Click in the chat, press Ctrl+V, then Send. The customer's number on the bill is used; it is asked for only when the bill has none.
- The project now has a [code signing policy](https://ajfan6t.github.io/BillForceWeb/code-signing/) and a [privacy policy](https://ajfan6t.github.io/BillForceWeb/privacy/): BILLFORCE sends nothing anywhere unless you ask it to.

### "Windows protected your PC"
The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

### Updating
Download the new `Billforce-Setup.exe` and run it. Your data and backups are kept.
